# `mise shell-alias set`

- **用法：** `mise shell-alias set <shell_alias> [COMMAND]`
- **别名：** `add`、`create`
- **作用：** 修改状态
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/shell_alias/set.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/shell_alias/set.rs)

Set a shell alias in the global config

Writes the global config (~/.config/mise/config.toml by default). To share
an alias with a project, add it under `[shell_alias]` in the project's
mise.toml.

## Arguments
- **`<shell_alias>`** — The alias name
- **`[COMMAND]`** — The command to run (or pass ALIAS=COMMAND)

## 标志
- **`-h --help`** — 显示帮助

## 示例

Define ll in every directory

```
mise shell-alias set ll "ls -la"
```

Use the ALIAS=COMMAND form

```
mise shell-alias set gs="git status"
```
